findings.text: follow-on: the expected due is read from the same mutable node.urgency object passed into build_state, so this assertion would stay green if build_state rewrote that object; compare with the independent deadline created by the test.

follow-on: the new duration branch duplicates reckon/crew/node.py:803 rather than extending or wrapping its existing parser, so accepted duration forms can drift between dispatch and the rest of crew.

item_verdicts.diff: commits e26d6b51, 1217f68a, and 06b65f3a were read against base 8f4d4651; the first adds routing and tests, the second repairs picker guidance and bounded state, and the third adds coordinator guidance.
item_verdicts.done_when: the source brief requires input, template, queueing, base-count regression, and a negative control; urgency-final.log records 27 passes, negative-control.log records the expected failure, and the paired regression logs each record 64 passes and the same two failures.
item_verdicts.goal: the source brief asks for due time and urgency in dispatch routing; reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:983 accepts both and reckon/crew/picker/prompts.py:370 renders them to the picker.
item_verdicts.manifest: the reviewed run's manifest.md names three commits, focused and paired regression logs, a negative-control log, and the two base-identical failure IDs; each named log was read.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source brief lists the original scope, and the two resume advice files explicitly extend it to reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py and skills/reckon-build/references/lane-routing.md; all eight diff paths fall within that combined scope.

justifications.durability: tests/test_dispatch_urgency.py:215 fails if an urgent lifted hold is silently queued, although the due equality at tests/test_dispatch_urgency.py:107 uses the same mutable node field as its expected value.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_dispatch_urgency.py:162 exercises urgent routing and its ordinary control; the reviewed run's urgency-final.log, negative-control.log, and paired regression logs record the required results.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/picker/prompts.py:25 reuses the shared UTC parser and reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1257 follows its surrounding Click validation pattern without forbidden names.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1176 preserves an urgent lifted-lane hold and reckon/crew/picker/templates/questions.jinja:1 tells the picker to compare local wait with remaining time while keeping service constraints.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:47 adds a duration parser that duplicates the s, m, and h capability already owned by reckon/crew/node.py:803, with a separate day suffix and case rule.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff's eight paths match the source brief plus the two explicit scope extensions, including reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:983 and skills/reckon-build/references/lane-routing.md:12.
